lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 저 드디어 새집을 구했어요!
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, I finally found a new place!
lines.beaver_roman: minsu ssi, jeo deudieo saejibeul guhaesseoyo!
lines.en: Really? You're moving out of the boarding house? Congrats!

lines.beaver_en: Yes, it's an officetel in the city center.
lines.en: You'll live in a city-center officetel? What about rent?

lines.beaver_en: It's jeonse, so there's no monthly rent.
lines.learner: 전세라서 집세를 안 낸다고요? 정말 좋네요.
lines.en: You don't pay rent because it's jeonse? That's great.
lines.roman: jeonseraseo jipsereul an naendagoyo? jeongmal jonneyo.

lines.beaver_en: There's a security office at the complex entrance, so it's safe.
lines.en: There's a security office at the complex entrance too?

lines.beaver: 네. 창가에서 강이 보여서 전망은 좋대요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes. They say the view is good—you can see the river.
lines.beaver_roman: ne. changgaeseo gangi boyeoseo jeonmangeun jotaeyo.
lines.en: You can see the river from the window? Sounds lovely.

lines.beaver: 네, 베란다도 넓어요. 화분을 키울 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the balcony is big too. I'll grow plants.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, berandado neolbeoyo. hwabuneul kiul geoyeyo.
lines.en: You'll grow plants on the balcony? And the master bedroom?

lines.beaver: 안방은 작지만 욕실이 두 개 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: The master bedroom is small, but there are two bathrooms.
lines.beaver_roman: anbangeun jakjiman yoksiri du gae isseoyo.
lines.learner: 욕실이 두 개 있다고요? 벽지는 어때요?
lines.roman: yoksiri du gae itdagoyo? byeokjineun eottaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: The owner says he'll change it to light green wallpaper.
lines.learner: 와, 벽지도 새로 바꿔 준다고요? 부러워요.
lines.en: Wow, he'll even put up new wallpaper? I'm jealous.
lines.roman: wa, byeokjido saero bakkwo jundagoyo? bureowoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You can go straight to the subway station by escalator.
lines.en: Straight there by escalator? That's a big city for you.

lines.beaver: 이웃집에 일본 사람이 산대요. 집들이 올래요?
lines.beaver_en: I hear a Japanese person lives next door. Come to my housewarming?
lines.beaver_roman: iutjibe ilbon sarami sandaeyo. jipdeuri ollaeyo?
lines.learner: 이웃집에 일본 사람이 산다고요? 꼭 갈게요!
lines.en: A Japanese person lives next door? I'll definitely come!
lines.roman: iutjibe ilbon sarami sandagoyo? kkok galgeyo!
